meta.summary: Strict controls for a scaling AI-native seed startup with envelopes set at 2.0x sector median to fund growth while capping runaway spend.

shadow_ai.reimbursement_rule: AI tool purchases on personal or employee cards are not reimbursable; all AI spend must route through the approved procurement workflow before the charge is incurred.

response_ladder.trigger: Team envelope reaches 75% consumed within the calendar month
Team envelope reaches 90% consumed or single-hour spend exceeds $20
Team envelope fully consumed or company envelope reaches 100%

rationales.e1: Production inference for the support-triage service at $211/day routes through the allowlisted Anthropic primary tier and maps to the $200/month Support envelope under the production COGS rule; no action required.
rationales.e2: Data usage on an allowlisted provider, inside its monthly envelope. Approved.
rationales.e3: A 96% cost-per-request increase with flat volume on the Search team signals a context-size regression or model-tier drift; this breaches the 20% variance band on the Engineering envelope and triggers a step-1 alert to the Engineering team lead.
rationales.e4: This is the third ChatGPT Team subscription on the Marketing employee card this quarter, exceeding the team_subscription_threshold of 1 duplicate; the charge is rerouted to the approved OpenAI primary-tier contract.
rationales.e5: The $4,800 fine-tune request from ML Platform exceeds the $1,000 fine_tune_over_usd threshold and requires CFO approval before the job is queued; the approval checklist UI will collect justification and cost-benefit documentation.
rationales.e6: The Growth team research agent reached 340 retries per hour, exceeding the 10-retry limit, and was burning $47/hr against the $20/hr kill threshold; the agent was terminated, preventing an estimated $1,090 in uncontrolled spend.
rationales.e7: The Growth team frontier-model exception for the demo build is within the 24-hour approval window and the $100 max_delta_usd cap; CFO approval is required before the routing change takes effect.
rationales.e8: A junior engineer personal API key at 22x baseline with no project tag triggers a step-2 throttle under the response ladder; Engineering lead must attribute the spend to an approved project tag within 2 hours or the key is blocked.
rationales.e9: The procurement agent's $499 dataset license purchase falls within the agent card's single_txn_ceiling_usd of $500 and the data-licensing merchant scope; the transaction is admitted.
rationales.e10: The Design team's $89/month AI video trial duplicates a capability already covered by the Sales team's $1,400/year contract at 40% seat utilization; rerouting to the existing contract recovers $840 in annualized unused seat value.
rationales.e11: A $120 charge from an unrecognized inference provider in Engineering triggers the new_provider_rule; the charge is held pending CTO approval and the provider must complete the security and data-terms questionnaire before further spend is authorized.
rationales.e12: Inference tagged to internal-tooling is classified OpEx under the project_tag rule; the COGS classification is corrected and the transaction is restated to the OpEx ledger.
rationales.e13: Month-to-date spend at 87% of the company envelope with 9 days remaining has crossed the 75% burn_alert_pct threshold; a step-1 alert was issued and team leads must submit revised run-rate forecasts to the CFO within 4 hours.
rationales.e14: Weekly rollup complete; all team envelopes, classification rules, and agent guardrails are within policy parameters.
